18-month investigation by St. Lucie County law enforcement
Operation Scoreboard, matching the candidate’s score-board operation anchor
November 5 announcement of a gang takedown involving racketeering arrests
novel_facts: Incoming specifies 11 Wednesday racketeering arrests and two outstanding warrants.

Its narrower Wednesday racketeering count does not by itself demonstrate a material update or independent follow-up.
